title: Rethinking Algorithmic Fairness for Human-AI Collaboration
reasoning: The paper focuses on mathematical and algorithmic fairness (specifically Equality of Opportunity) and racial bias within the context of human-AI collaboration for criminal sentencing. It evaluates these concepts using historical court data and gradient-boosted decision trees, rather than benchmarking religion, spiritual traditions, or moral/ethical reasoning systems. Furthermore, the study does not involve Large Language Models (LLMs).
